interface.name: ukui_startup_info_v2
interface.description: The startup_info object provides a way sets the startup geometry of the taskbar/desktop entry for app. The object will auto destroy when arrive the retire time.

request.name: set_startup_geometry
request.description: Sets the startup geometry of the taskbar/desktop entry. Coordinates are global.

request.name: set_pid
request.description: The pid determines which process will use the startup_geometry. The child process of this process will also use the startup_geometry.

request.name: set_appid
request.description: The appid determines which app should use the startup_geometry. It only uses when not set pid or not find the app from pid.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Must call destroy after set info completely.
